# VB条件分岐：原文根拠

入口：[業務別一覧](VB機能・条件分岐一覧.md)。対象ソースから抽出した分岐・反復の式と周辺コードです。

周辺コードは分岐を読み直すための抜粋であり、処理全体やネスト全体を示すものではありません。行番号リンクから原本メソッドを確認してください。

               delivery.SeniMotoKbn = Mcm1005uConstant.SENIMOTO_TENPO _
             Then
                '' 状態が破棄・解約、承認状態が審査中・承認中の場合：編集不可

                Me.KeiyakuHakoButton.Enabled = False
                Me.KEIYAKU_NOTextBox.ReadOnly = True
                Me.JIDOKOSIN_FLGCheckBox.Enabled = False
                Me.KEIYAKU_DTTextBox.ReadOnly = True
                Me.KAIYAKU_DTTextBox.ReadOnly = True
                Me.KEIYAKUMANRYO_DTTextBox.ReadOnly = True

        For i As Integer = 0 To nenCount

#### F1011-09-004-B001　行163～173

```vb
    Private Function UnionJotai(ByVal union As String, ByVal value As String) As String

        If union = Nothing Then
            union = value
        Else
            union = union & " " & value
        End If

        Return union

    End Function
```

    Private Sub HissuError(ByVal monthText As String, ByVal kikanText As String)

        If IsNull(monthText) Or IsNull(kikanText) Then
            DisplayMessage(CPMessageConstant.FWM_0001, Mcm3004uConstant.REQUIRED_MESSAGE)
        End If

        '' 基準月がyyyy/MMか判定する
        If Not IsDate(monthText & "/01") Then
            DisplayMessage(CPMessageConstant.FWM_0006, _
                           New String() {Mcm3004uConstant.KIJUNZUKI_NK, CPConstant.FORMAT_YYYYMM})
        End If
```

        '' 基準月がyyyy/MMか判定する

        End If

        '' 対象期間が数値型か判定する
        If Not IsNumeric(kikanText) Then
            DisplayMessage(CPMessageConstant.FWM_0003, _
                           Mcm3004uConstant.TAISHOKIKAN_NK)
```

<a id="C01"></a>

## C01　日付・整数の比較

IsCheckRelationは第1引数<=第2引数でTrue。呼出側で引数順が逆なら同日を拒否する条件にもなる。

原本：[CPCommonUtility.vb:264](<../../参照用/MCM_javaコンバート用/MCM_作業用/MCM_作業用/10_FRAMEWORK/UTILITY/CPCommonUtility.vb>)～307

```vb
    Public Shared Function IsCheckRelation(ByVal fromdate As Date, _
                                           ByVal todate As Date) As Boolean

        Dim judgment As Boolean     '' 判定格納変数

        If fromdate <= todate Then
            '' 開始日が終了日以前のとき、"True"をjudgmentへ格納する
            judgment = True
        Else
            '' 開始日が終了日より後のとき、"False"をjudgmentへ格納する
            judgment = False
        End If

        '' 判定結果を返す
        Return judgment

    End Function


    ''' <summary>
    ''' 数値妥当性チェック
    ''' </summary>
    ''' <param name="startValue">数値A</param>
    ''' <param name="endValue">数値B</param>
    ''' <returns></returns>
    ''' <remarks>数値の妥当性チェックをする</remarks>
    Public Shared Function IsCheckRelation(ByVal startValue As Integer, _
                                           ByVal endValue As Integer) As Boolean

        Dim judgment As Boolean     '' 判定格納変数

        If startValue <= endValue Then
            '' 数値Aが数値B以下のとき、"True"をjudgmentへ格納する
            judgment = True
        Else
            '' 数値Aが数値Bより大きいとき、"False"をjudgmentへ格納する
            judgment = False
        End If

        '' 判定結果を返す
        Return judgment

    End Function

```

<a id="C03"></a>

## C03　審査・承認の通知候補取得

getShoninJohoはLEVEL>1の親階層から先頭1候補を返す。金額のWHERE比較は上位候補MOAではなく、対象ログインIDのMOBの上限を使い、NVL(上限,999999999999)>金額という厳密な大小条件。0件ならアドレス等を空にする。上位者の上限で判定すると読み替えず、FROM・TOと画面側の条件も確認する。

原本：[McmGetNewDataUtility.vb:218](<../../参照用/MCM_javaコンバート用/MCM_作業用/MCM_作業用/20_COMMON/UTILITY/McmGetNewDataUtility.vb>)～269

```vb
    Public Shared Function getShoninJoho(ByVal kingaku As String, _
                                         ByVal loginId As String, _
                                         ByVal kingakuCul As String) As McmGetNewData_Shonin

        Dim returnList As McmGetNewData_Shonin = New McmGetNewData_Shonin

        Dim sql As String = _
            " SELECT MOB.TANTO_ID" & _
            "       ,MOB.LOGIN_ID" & _
            "       ,MOB.TANTO_NK" & _
            "       ,MOB.MAILADDRESS  AS FROM_MAILADDRESS" & _
            "       ,MOA.TANTO_NK AS OYATANTO_NK" & _
            "       ,MOA.MAILADDRESS  AS TO_MAILADDRESS" & _
            "       ,MOA." & kingakuCul & _
            "       ,MOA.LOGIN_ID AS OYALOGIN_ID" & _
            "   FROM MCM_MO_TANTO MOA" & _
            "       , (SELECT * FROM MCM_MO_TANTO WHERE LOGIN_ID = '" & loginId & "') MOB" & _
            "  WHERE NVL(MOB." & kingakuCul & ",999999999999) > " & kingaku & _
            "    AND LEVEL > 1" & _
            " START WITH MOA.LOGIN_ID = '" & loginId & "'" & _
            " CONNECT BY PRIOR MOA.OYALOGIN_ID = MOA.LOGIN_ID " & _
            " ORDER BY LEVEL"
        Dim sqlReadList As List(Of List(Of Object)) = CPDBUtility.ExecuteRead(sql)

        If sqlReadList.Count >= 1 Then
            ''1件の場合
            returnList.TANTO_ID = CPCommonUtility.ToZeroFromNull(sqlReadList(0).Item(SHONINSQL_TANTO_ID))
            returnList.LOGIN_ID = CPCommonUtility.ToKuhakuFromNull(sqlReadList(0).Item(SHONINSQL_LOGIN_ID))
            returnList.TANTO_NK = CPCommonUtility.ToKuhakuFromNull(sqlReadList(0).Item(SHONINSQL_TANTO_NK))
            returnList.FROM_MAILADDRESS = CPCommonUtility.ToKuhakuFromNull(sqlReadList(0).Item(SHONINSQL_FROM_MAILADDRESS))
            returnList.OYATANTO_NK = CPCommonUtility.ToKuhakuFromNull(sqlReadList(0).Item(SHONINSQL_OYATANTO_NK))
            returnList.TO_MAILADDRESS = CPCommonUtility.ToKuhakuFromNull(sqlReadList(0).Item(SHONINSQL_TO_MAILADDRESS))
            returnList.KINGAKU = CPCommonUtility.ToZeroFromNull(sqlReadList(0).Item(SHONINSQL_KINGAKU))
            returnList.OYALOGIN_ID = CPCommonUtility.ToKuhakuFromNull(sqlReadList(0).Item(SHONINSQL_OYALOGIN_ID))

        Else
            returnList.TANTO_ID = 0
            returnList.LOGIN_ID = ""
            returnList.TANTO_NK = ""
            returnList.FROM_MAILADDRESS = ""
            returnList.OYATANTO_NK = ""
            returnList.TO_MAILADDRESS = ""
            returnList.KINGAKU = 0
            returnList.OYALOGIN_ID = ""

        End If

        Return returnList

    End Function

End Class
```

<a id="C04"></a>

## C04　担当者設定からのログイン情報

担当者の保守・審査・承認フラグ、金額上限、利用権限1～8を読込む。現在のDB値・上位者設定は実環境で確認する。

原本：[McmLogin\_UserInfo.xml:1](<../../参照用/MCM_javaコンバート用/MCM_作業用/MCM_作業用/20_COMMON/LOGIN/McmLogin_UserInfo.xml>)～34

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<SQL>
  <SELECT>
    MOA.TANTO_NK
    ,MOA.JIGYOSYO_NK
    ,MOA.MAILADDRESS
    ,MOA.LOGIN_ID
    ,MOA.MAINTENANCE_FLG
    ,MOA.SHINSA_FLG
    ,MOA.MITSUMORI_KIN
    ,MOA.KEIYAKU_KIN
    ,MOA.SHONIN_FLG
    ,MOA.MITSUMORISHONIN_KIN
    ,MOA.KEIYAKUSHONIN_KIN
    ,(SELECT MOB.RIYOKENGEN_KBN FROM MCM_MO_TANTOKENGEN MOB WHERE MOB.TANTO_ID = MOA.TANTO_ID AND MOB.KENGENBUNRUI_ID = 1) AS RIYOKENGEN1_KBN
    ,(SELECT MOB.RIYOKENGEN_KBN FROM MCM_MO_TANTOKENGEN MOB WHERE MOB.TANTO_ID = MOA.TANTO_ID AND MOB.KENGENBUNRUI_ID = 2) AS RIYOKENGEN2_KBN
    ,(SELECT MOB.RIYOKENGEN_KBN FROM MCM_MO_TANTOKENGEN MOB WHERE MOB.TANTO_ID = MOA.TANTO_ID AND MOB.KENGENBUNRUI_ID = 3) AS RIYOKENGEN3_KBN
    ,(SELECT MOB.RIYOKENGEN_KBN FROM MCM_MO_TANTOKENGEN MOB WHERE MOB.TANTO_ID = MOA.TANTO_ID AND MOB.KENGENBUNRUI_ID = 4) AS RIYOKENGEN4_KBN
    ,(SELECT MOB.RIYOKENGEN_KBN FROM MCM_MO_TANTOKENGEN MOB WHERE MOB.TANTO_ID = MOA.TANTO_ID AND MOB.KENGENBUNRUI_ID = 5) AS RIYOKENGEN5_KBN
    ,(SELECT MOB.RIYOKENGEN_KBN FROM MCM_MO_TANTOKENGEN MOB WHERE MOB.TANTO_ID = MOA.TANTO_ID AND MOB.KENGENBUNRUI_ID = 6) AS RIYOKENGEN6_KBN
    ,(SELECT MOB.RIYOKENGEN_KBN FROM MCM_MO_TANTOKENGEN MOB WHERE MOB.TANTO_ID = MOA.TANTO_ID AND MOB.KENGENBUNRUI_ID = 7) AS RIYOKENGEN7_KBN
    ,(SELECT MOB.RIYOKENGEN_KBN FROM MCM_MO_TANTOKENGEN MOB WHERE MOB.TANTO_ID = MOA.TANTO_ID AND MOB.KENGENBUNRUI_ID = 8) AS RIYOKENGEN8_KBN
  </SELECT>
  <FROM>
     MCM_MO_TANTO MOA
  </FROM>
  <WHERE>
    <CONDITION>MOA.LOGIN_ID = :{0}</CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>MOA.PASSWORD = :{1}</CONDITION>
    <CONDITION>MOA.SYSTEMRIYO_FLG = '1'</CONDITION>
  </WHERE>
  <ORDERBY>
  </ORDERBY>
</SQL>
```
